title: Why Does Your Nose Run When You Cry?

scenes.text: Ever notice tears make your nose flood?
People think crying just fills your eyes with water.
scenes.label: Crying only fills eyes

scenes.text: The lacrimal ducts connect the eye to the nasal cavity, so tears drain into the nose, causing a runny nose.
scenes.label: Tears drain to nose

scenes.text: Your nose is a tear outlet!
scenes.label: Nose = Tear Outlet
scenes.sub: Your nasal passage clears eye fluid.

scenes.text: Follow for facts that sound fake but aren't.

description: The surprising link between tears and a runny nose explained in seconds. Unlock more hidden body facts.
